body:
Hi, when I try to launch the nightly build, after installation, a pop up says that it is corrupted and suggests me to move it (the application) to the bin.

I think that it must be authorised to run on Mac, but right now I can't remember what is the command.

On another note, I have rebuilt the APP from source, up to the latest current commit (this is done with a comprehensive build script created with Claude which takes care of all the dependencies and is  based on the yaml file).

Now, what I have noticed is that: 

- if the RAW's folder contains a space in its path (possibly other non alphanumeric characters), ART keeps failing opening the image and the path bar shows the folder path with a `%20` in place of the space. 
- if the folder doesn't contain a space, the image is opened correctly and its current directory is also chosen in ART's file manager.
